proposition.claim:
For A>-1 and N>(1+A)^−1, the paper's shifted vectors F_j span an M-dimensional positive subspace of H(k;A).

A=-1/4,omega=1,T=2pi,k=-7/2,N=2,j=2; A>-1,N>4/3; trigonometric symbol satisfies smoothness; every real k allowed.

repair.content: Set Ftilde_j[n]=gamma_n^−1 on each shifted block and zero elsewhere. Finite support avoids any unbounded-inverse use; mixed forms vanish; every diagonal form=(1+A)N−1>0. Arbitrary M gives infinite positive eigenvalues, symmetry gives negative counterpart; semidefinite cases unchanged.
